title: Concept: Go dependency pinned to a prerelease tag
description: go.mod declares a prerelease module version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Prereleases sit outside most advisory ranges and carry no stability promise, so a known defect can ship behind a deliberate pin.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: Prereleases sit outside most advisory ranges and carry no stability promise, so a known defect can ship behind a deliberate pin.
